correctness.rationale: The cubic Euler characteristic is reconstructed from the exact tangent Chern class. The archival cubic/Fano relation gives the exact identity \(\chi(F_d)=\chi(Y_d)(\chi(Y_d)-3)/2\). For even dimension, the only even factor is \(\chi(Y_d)-3\), whose valuation equals that of \(3d-4\) because \(|3d-4|<2^{d+2}\). For odd dimension, the only even factor is \(\chi(Y_d)\), whose valuation equals that of \(3d+5\) because \(3d+5<2^{d+2}\). Division by two gives the claimed formulas. The exact embedded checker independently reproduces the Chern-class formula and verifies the valuation law through dimension five thousand.

value.rationale: Fano varieties of lines on smooth cubic hypersurfaces are central objects in algebraic geometry, with markedly different geometry across dimensions. The theorem extracts an exact and unexpectedly simple dyadic law for a global topological invariant across the entire family. It gives a complete parity classification and, more strongly, an exact two-residue-class description for every possible two-adic valuation level.
